subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should catalog creation remain a generic core new-session target validated per selected agent, or should each catalog provider own creation through a dedicated method?
rationale: The PR establishes new gateway protocol and plugin SDK semantics whose permanent ownership and agent-scoping cannot be resolved safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Keep generic target
options.body: Retain the additive capability, validate it against the selected agent's runtime policy, and document the narrow contract.

options.title: Use provider-owned creation
options.body: Replace the model target with a provider-owned catalog method that prepares or creates the appropriate core session.

options.title: Defer creation API
options.body: Land only the independent hierarchy and deduplication work until the catalog creation contract is sponsored separately.

recommendation.title: Keep generic target
recommendation.body: Retain the additive capability, validate it against the selected agent's runtime policy, and document the narrow contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the multi-agent routing, plugin ownership, and public SDK boundaries associated with this contributor area.
